title: Moana
description: The Polynesian island of Motunui is created and powered by forces of nature. Its inhabitants worship the goddess of nature Te Fiti, who brought life to the ocean. But when Maui (Dwayne Johnson), the shape-shifting demigod of the wind and sea, steals the heart of the ocean to give humanity the power of creation, things go wrong. A thousand years later, Moana (Auli?i Cravalho), daughter of Motunui's chief, comes to her village’s rescue.
